title: mariscus praelongatus
intro: Mariscus praelongatus, commonly known as Soft Sword Sedge, is a type of plant species in the family Cyperaceae. The Soft Sword Sedge is traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mariscus praelongatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
